name: checkout-discount-reformat
problem: TypeError reading 'amount' when the payment gateway returns no discount
expected_root_cause: Handle undefined response from payments gateway
notes: Subtle case: the culprit commit replaced the discountRate || 0 fallback with payment.response.discount.amount, and a later cosmetic commit ('Reformat checkout with tabs') touched the same line, so raw git blame points at the innocent reformat. Diff analysis detects the whitespace-only commit and drops it (0.15x penalty), letting the true culprit rank first deterministically. Without diff analysis the culprit would only surface via the recent-commit + error-keyword boost.
